scenarios.expected: Status labels use their configured Stage mapping and each successful move is visible. An archived/read-only record offers no unsupported mutation; renaming a Status does not change its Stage.
scenarios.actual: Menu label "Move to" listed each Status with its Stage (e.g. Out for signature · Signature); moves recorded Internal review→review, Awaiting approval→approval, Out for signature→signature, Active→active; the header Stage button read "<Stage> — move contract" and the Status name showed beside the reference after each; Out for signature created no Envelope and Active filed no Document; History showed 4 status changes. Active → Internal review accepted (Stage review); the Administrator's new Status renamed to "Rev renamed review legal_team_member 20260907133231" still listed and mapped as Review; Review → Active skipped Approval and Signature. Move past approval listed Priya Raman Pending; Cancel kept Awaiting approval; Move anyway saved Out for signature; History reads "moved this contract past approval, overriding Priya Raman"; the approval is still pending. Expired mapped to Ended and the Description still saved; archived record showed no Stage control and a direct status write answered 409; Restore left it Expired; the control then reopened it as Active. Ravi Menon (Contributor on the team) saw no Stage control and got 403; Priya Raman outside the Confidential team got 404; the Status stayed Active.
